# SEC-006: Docker client config is readable by its owner only

- **Group:** Secrets on disk
- **Severity when it fails:** moderate
- **Root:** the full result needs `sudo`. Without root this check reports `unknown`, never a pass.

## Why it matters

docker login stores registry credentials base64 encoded (not encrypted) in ~/.docker/config.json unless a credential helper is set. A group or world readable file hands out push and pull access to your registries.

## Verify by hand

```sh
stat -c '%a %U' /root/.docker/config.json /home/*/.docker/config.json
```

## How to fix it

chmod 600 the file, and configure a credential helper so passwords are not stored in it.

<https://docs.docker.com/reference/cli/docker/login/#credential-stores>
